svg.style: width: 100%; height: auto; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
svg.title: How the power quality classifier works, in five stages
svg.desc: Five stages flow downward: a signal factory makes 5800 fake power signals, noise is added to make 29000, a measuring stage turns each into 191 numbers, the data is split into study and exam sets, and four learners vote on an answer that scores 0.69.

g.text: a wiggly line → a row of numbers
all 5 noisy copies stay on one side

svg.text: You type 5 commands. Each file above runs when you name it. Nothing else needs touching.
Total time on a normal laptop: about 45 minutes, mostly waiting.
